triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '8. Manually setting up TMA mbarrier hangs the kernel' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 8. Manually setting up TMA mbarrier hangs the kernel

problem.statement: CuTeDSL GDN Decode on sm_120 — Pitfalls -- 8. Manually setting up TMA mbarrier hangs the kernel

payload.attempted: Skip the high-level `tma_load` wrapper, write your own:
payload.lesson: Don't hand-roll mbarrier for TMA. Use:

established_fact.mechanism: The mbarrier protocol has subtle requirements: arrival count, phase semantics, fence visibility, transaction count semantics. The `cuTeXDsl` helpers in `tma_load` exist precisely because this is so easy to get wrong (the dense_gemm sm_120 reference uses `tma_load`).

payload.observed: Kernel never returns. Job killed after 30+ minutes.
payload.root_cause: The mbarrier protocol has subtle requirements: arrival count, phase semantics, fence visibility, transaction count semantics. The `cuTeXDsl` helpers in `tma_load` exist precisely because this is so easy to get wrong (the dense_gemm sm_120 reference uses `tma_load`).
